d:
Long, flowing platinum white hair with straight-cut bangs and a coarse texture. Sharp, cold pale blue eyes with a vacant, haunting expression. Apparent age is late teens with a mature, solemn demeanor. Slender build. A tattered, oversized dark navy blue school coat worn over a greyish-white dress with a torn collar. A halo of distorted, glitching white geometric rings floats above the head.
BODY COLOR: pale ivory
